m: 1. लज् (cf. √ लज्ज्) cl. 6. Ā. लजते (only 3. pl. pf. लेजिरे, Bhaṭṭ.), to be ashamed, Dhātup. xxviii, 10.
2. लज् (cf. √ 1. लञ्ज्) cl. 1. P. लजति ‘to fry’ or ‘to blame’ (भर्जने v.l. भर्त्सने), Dhātup. vii, 64.
3. लज् (cf. √ 2. लञ्ज्) cl. 10. P. लजयति, to appear (प्रकाशने), Dhātup. xxxv, 66.
a: लज् — {vI.v} {c6c} A. (लजते) To be ashamed. {vII.v} {c1c} P. (लजति) To blame &c.; see लंज् I. {vIII.v} {c10c} P. (लजयति) 1 To seem, appear, shine. --2 To cover, conceal; (according to some लाजयति also in this sense).

(Dhātup. xxviii, 10) लज्जते (ep. also ˚ति; pf. ललज्जे, 3. pl. ˚ज्जिरे, Kathās.; fut. लज्जिता, लज्जिष्यते Gr.; aor. अलज्जिष्ट, Bhaṭṭ.; inf. लज्जितुम्, MBh. &c.), to be ashamed, blush, MBh.; Kāv. &c.: Caus. लज्जयति (or लज्जापयति?), to cause any one (acc.) to be ashamed, inspire with shame, Kāv.; Rājat. : Desid. लिलज्जिषते Gr.: Intens. लालज्ज्यते, ib.

a: लज्जा — [लज्ज् भावे अ] 1 Shame, कामातुराणां न भयं न लज्जा Subhāṣ.; विहाय लज्जां R. 2. 40; Ku. 1. 48. --2 Bashfulness, modesty; शृंगारलज्जां निरूपयति Ś. 1; Ku. 3. 7; R. 7. 25; लज्जे त्वं मज्ज सिंधौ Subhāṣ. --3 N. of the sensitive plant. --Comp. --अन्वित a. modest, bashful. --आवह, --कर a. (रा or री f.) causing shame, shameful, disgraceful, ignominious; Pt. 5. 10. --शील a. bashful, modest. --रहित, --शून्य, --हीन, a. shameless, impudent, immodest.
